findings.message: 45 rule(s) from the current Unity ignore template are missing: .utmp/, *.log, *.blend1.meta, /[Mm]emoryCaptures/, /[Rr]ecordings/, …

findings.message: This repository has no LFS hooks, so LFS-tracked files are not uploaded on push.
findings.hint: Without the pre-push hook, a push sends pointer files whose contents were never uploaded.

findings.message: 12 binary file type(s) in this project are not tracked by LFS: .FBX, .blend, .exr, .fbx, .mp3, .pdf, .png, .psd, …
findings.hint: Future commits of these types go to LFS. Copies already committed stay in history until migrated.

findings.message: 1 git package dependency(s) track a branch instead of a tag or commit: com.annulusgames.lit-motion
findings.hint: The same Packages/manifest.json resolves to different code on different machines and in CI. Pin each one to a tag or a full commit hash.

findings.message: 2 git package dependency(s) name a revision that is either a tag or a branch: com.rlabrecque.steamworks.net, dev.purrnet.purrnet
findings.hint: Telling the two apart needs a request to each dependency's host, which this audit never makes. Check them with git ls-remote --heads <url> <revision>, then pin anything that turns out to be a branch.
